## 报道摘要 | Report summary

**中文。** 阿塞拜疆卡拉巴赫卡纳瓦尔泰佩（Canavartəpə）遗址的 2026 年发掘，记录了一座圆角长方形半地穴式房屋（L3425）和一处相互连通的多室半地穴式建筑（L3427、L3440、L3444）。多室建筑的填土出土泥封残片。新增建筑平面和地层关系可用来比较晚铜石并用时代住居形式和空间组织；泥封提供了研究封缄活动的线索。

**English.** The 2026 excavations at Canavartepe in Azerbaijan’s Karabakh region documented a rounded-corner rectangular semi-subterranean house (L3425) and an interconnected multi-room semi-subterranean complex (L3427, L3440 and L3444). Fill in the multi-room complex yielded fragments of clay sealings. The new plans and stratigraphic relationships broaden the evidence for Late Chalcolithic domestic layouts and spatial organization; the sealings provide evidence for investigating sealing practices.

## 日期与既往工作 | Dates and earlier work

**中文。** 阿塞拜疆国家科学院考古与人类学研究所报告，2026 年田野季为 6 月 25 日至 8 月 24 日，未给出各建筑或泥封的发现日。报告所列领队为 Khagani Almammadov、共同领队为 Mark Iserlis。11 月 23 日是机构报告日期，不是发掘日期。本遗址已有早期发掘和论文，本期只报道 2026 年新增材料。

**English.** The Azerbaijan National Academy of Sciences’ Institute of Archaeology and Anthropology dates its field season to 25 June–24 August 2026; individual feature and find dates are not stated. The report lists Khagani Almammadov as expedition lead and Mark Iserlis as co-director. The institute reported on 23 November, distinct from the fieldwork dates. Earlier excavations at the settlement have already been published.

## 解释边界 | Limits of interpretation

**中文。** 泥封出自填土，不能直接确定其中任何一间房的原始功能；也不足以证明中央集权或特定行政层级。建筑的精细年代和活动面识别仍待完整发表。

**English.** Sealings in fill do not establish the original function of any room or demonstrate centralized authority or a specific administrative hierarchy. More detailed publication is needed for feature chronology and activity surfaces.
